title: Deep metal hall (z11): landing, bar, finished-goods and bin piles
description: Stockpiles for the z11 smelting and forging hall (8 magma smelters x103-114 y103-108, 4 magma forges x103-108 y92-97). Q11 is the 1x1 landing tile under the planned drop chute at (100,104); smelters take from it. BAR-Deep holds bars in bins between smelters and forges. FG-Deep bins forge output and gives to the TREAS vault piles on z111. BIN-Deep stores empty bins.
hotkey: (100,104,11), the chute landing in the z11 hall

phases.label: Q11: 1x1 quantum landing at (100,104), ore, economic stone and rough gems
BAR-Deep: metal bars in bins, x110-118 y92-100
FG-Deep: finished goods in bins, x97-102 y92-97, gives to the TREAS piles

manual_steps: After placing, run the stockpile tool: BIN-Deep furniture_types ["BIN"]; BAR-Deep blocks_off true (the bar preset leaves stone blocks ticked); Q11 stone_untick ["@PLAIN"].
Workshop links (each workshop's menu): z11 smelters take from Q11; z11 forges take from BAR-Deep.
Q11 fills once the drop chute from z20 is dug; until then it stays empty.
Undo: run this blueprint with undo=true.
